summary: Trinity County, CA wooden lookout tower finished in 1934 to replace the Blake lookout; a 2021 blog visit found the tower gone, with only wood struts and remnants left.

facts.status_note: A 2021 blog visit found the tower gone, with a few wood struts and other remnants at the site; OpenStreetMap tags the spot as ruins

visit.trail_note: A 2021 blog describes parking on the far side of road 2N43 and walking up it; the last stretch is overgrown. No agency page on visitor access was found.

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone holds: the 2021 blog found only remnants, and the FFLA California index row for Cold Springs (Trinity) reads Tower, Gone, with no registry number. No agency or current access source was found, so no access level is recorded. The Forest Lookouts index also lists a Cold Springs under Humboldt County; this record follows the Trinity County heading and the FFLA coordinates. CAL FIRE's Lookouts list has a different Cold Springs Lookout in its Mendocino column (not this site). The 1934 facts rest on newspaper excerpts as transcribed on the Forest Lookouts page; the original newspaper was not read. Today's condition rests on one blog visit.
